She defended constitutional Article 70 as protecting and strengthening democracy and said the Awami League had narrowed rural-urban gaps and improved development indicators, citing lower poverty and child and maternal mortality between 2006 and 2022.","notes":["The excerpt supports Hasina's claim that Article 70 protected and strengthened democracy, but not the summary's wording that it protected governmental stability."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0008-E008","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"At an October 2023 rally, Hasina dismissed BNP threats to remove her government, described BNP-Jamaat as killers, looters and terrorists, and contrasted it with the Awami League's claims of peace and development. At the same event she inaugurated the 9.39-kilometre Bangabandhu tunnel, costing Tk 10,689 crore, inaugurated 11 completed projects, and laid foundation stones for six development projects.","notes":["The excerpt says she laid foundation stones for six projects; it does not say she launched them."]}]}
